title: 第一章重来第二章族比第三章 锋芒
content_zh:
天玄大陆，青州，方家。
夜深人静，月光如水，洒在青瓦白墙的方家大宅上，像铺了一层薄霜。更夫敲着梆子走过长街，声音悠远绵长。
“啊——！”
一声惨叫划破寂静，紧接着是拳拳到肉的闷响，混杂着肆意的嘲笑声。
“废物就是废物！连淬体一重都突破不了，活着也是浪费粮食！”
方家后院的一处偏僻墙角，七八个少年围成一圈，拳脚如雨点般落在蜷缩在地的人身上。那少年不过十五六岁，衣衫破烂，浑身泥土，嘴角溢出的鲜血顺着下巴滴在青石板上。他死死护住头部，咬紧牙关，一声不吭。
领头的是方家大房长子方烈，十七岁，身高七尺，虎背熊腰，淬体六重修为，是方家年轻一辈公认的翘楚。他居高临下地看着脚下像死狗一样的少年，嘴角挂着轻蔑的笑，一脚踩在少年背上，用力碾了碾。
“方圆，你爹方沧海当年不是号称‘青州第一天才’吗？怎么生了你这么个废物儿子？”方烈蹲下身，揪住少年的头发把他的脸提起来，“淬体一重都突破不了，十四年啊，你就是头猪也该开窍了吧？”
周围的少年哄堂大笑。
“烈哥别说了，人家可是‘天才’之后呢，哈哈哈！”
“天才之后？我看是废物之后！”
“他爹十五岁的时候已经淬体九重了好吗？这废物给他爹提鞋都不配！”
方圆的脸被按在地上，粗糙的石板磨破了脸颊的皮肉，火辣辣的疼。他没有挣扎，没有哀求，眼眸漆黑如墨，没有愤怒，没有恐惧，只有一种诡异的平静。
这种平静让方烈莫名烦躁。他见过被打的人哭喊求饶，见过被打的人愤怒反抗，唯独没见过这种——像是一潭死水，又像是一口深不见底的古井。
“看你妈呢！”方烈一巴掌抽在方圆脸上，站起身，“明天族比你若敢参加，我打断你的腿！滚出方家，方家不养废物！”
他一脚将方圆踢出三米远，带着人扬长而去。
笑声渐行渐远，后院恢复了寂静。
方圆躺在冰冷的地面上，浑身是伤，动弹不得。夜风吹过，带着初秋的凉意，吹动他破烂的衣角。
他睁着眼睛望着星空。
天玄大陆的夜空和记忆中的某个地方不太一样。这里没有九重天阙的七彩极光，没有诸天星辰汇聚的银河瀑布，只有一轮圆月和稀疏的星子，平淡得像一幅水墨画。

方圆嘴角突然勾起一抹弧度。
他等这一天，已经等了十八年。
不，准确地说——是两世为人。
前世，他名号“玄帝”，纵横诸天万界，镇压八荒六合，是站在九天之巅的最强者。他一手创立玄天殿，麾下三十六天将、七十二地煞，随便拉出来一个都是能掀翻一方大陆的巨擘。
他修炼三百年，渡劫九十九次，从未败过。
唯有一次。
渡那第十重天劫“万古大劫”时，天罚之力远超预期，九天神雷、灭世黑炎、时空乱流三劫齐至，他拼尽全力挡下了两劫，却被时空乱流撕碎了元神。
临死前他动用禁术“轮回往生诀”，将元神碎片投入轮回，重活一世。
然后他发现自己成了方家一个十四岁的废物。
前身的记忆涌入脑海，他花了大半年时间才完全融合。这具身体的主人——也叫方圆，是方家旁系子弟，父亲方沧海曾是青州赫赫有名的天才，十五岁淬体九重，十八岁踏入凝气境，被誉为“青州百年第一”。
然而十五年前，方沧海外出历练，一去不返，生死不明。母亲在生下他后难产而死。
失去了天才父亲的庇护，方圆在方家的地位一落千丈。方家是大族，讲究实力为尊，没有背景、没有天赋、没有靠山的孩子，就是人人可欺的野草。
方圆缓缓坐起，抹去嘴角血迹，目光深邃如渊。
“方烈，方家……”他低声自语，声音沙哑却带着一种超越年龄的沉稳，“我闭关太久了，久到连蝼蚁都敢在我面前张狂。”
前身十四年无法突破淬体一重，所有人都以为是天赋太差，是废物中的废物。
但方圆融合记忆后发现了真相——这具身体天生经脉闭塞，丹田萎缩，确实是万年难遇的“绝脉之体”。放在普通人眼中，这就是废材中的废材，修炼之路断死。
但在他玄帝眼中——
这是万中无一的修炼奇才！
绝脉之体的经脉虽然闭塞，但血肉骨骼的承受能力远超常人。普通人的经脉像河道，灵力可以顺畅流淌；绝脉之体没有河道，但他的血肉就是大海，不需要河道也能存储海量的力量。
content_en:
Tianxuan Continent, Qingzhou, Fang Family.
In the dead of night, the moonlight is like water, shining on the Fang family's mansion with green tiles and white walls, like a thin layer of frost. The watchman walked through the long street banging his clapper, his voice long and distant.
"Ah——!"
A scream broke the silence, followed by the muffled sound of fists hitting the flesh, mixed with wanton ridicule.
"Waste is waste! You can't even break through the first level of body tempering, and living is just a waste of food!"
In a remote corner of the Fang family's backyard, seven or eight teenagers gathered in a circle, and fists and kicks fell like raindrops on the people huddled on the ground. The young man was only fifteen or sixteen years old. His clothes were in tatters and he was covered in dirt. The blood overflowing from the corner of his mouth dripped down his chin onto the bluestone. He protected his head tightly, gritted his teeth and remained silent.
The leader is Fang Lie, the eldest son of the Fang family. He is seventeen years old, seven feet tall, with a strong back and strong waist, and has a sixth level of body tempering cultivation. He is recognized as the leader of the younger generation of the Fang family. He looked down at the young man who looked like a dead dog at his feet, with a contemptuous smile on his lips, stepped on the young man's back, and crushed him hard.
"Fang Yuan, wasn't your father Fang Canghai known as the 'Number One Genius in Qingzhou' back then? Why did he give birth to such a useless son like you?" Fang Lie knelt down, grabbed the boy's hair and lifted his face up, "You can't break through one level of body tempering. It's been fourteen years. You're a pig, right?"
The surrounding teenagers burst into laughter.
"Brother Lie, stop talking, I am a 'genius', hahaha!"
"The Queen of Geniuses? I think she is the Queen of Trash!"
"His father was already at the ninth level of body tempering when he was fifteen, okay? This loser is not even worthy of carrying his father's shoes!"
Fangyuan's face was pressed to the ground, and the rough stone slabs scratched the skin of his cheeks, causing burning pain. He didn't struggle, didn't plead, his eyes were as dark as ink, there was no anger, no fear, just a strange calmness.
This kind of calm made Fang Lie inexplicably irritable. He had seen beaten people crying and begging for mercy, and seen beaten people resisting in anger, but he had never seen this kind of thing - like a pool of stagnant water, or an ancient well with no bottom.
"Look at your mother!" Fang Lie slapped Fang Yuan on the face and stood up, "If you dare to participate in the Tomorrow clan competition, I will break your legs! Get out of the Fang family, the Fang family does not raise waste!"
He kicked Fang Yuan three meters away and walked away with the people.
The laughter faded away and silence returned to the backyard.
Fangyuan was lying on the cold ground, covered in injuries and unable to move. The night wind blew by, bringing with it the coolness of early autumn, fluttering the corners of his tattered clothes.
He stared at the stars with his eyes open.
The night sky of Tianxuan Continent is different from somewhere in my memory. There is no colorful aurora of the Nine Heavens Tower, no Milky Way waterfall where all the stars in the sky gather. There is only a full moon and sparse stars, as plain as an ink painting.
The corners of Fangyuan's mouth suddenly curved.
He has been waiting for this day for eighteen years.
No, to be precise - two lives.
In his previous life, he was known as "Xuan Emperor", and he traveled across all the heavens and realms, suppressing the eight wastelands and six places. He was the strongest person standing on the top of the Nine Heavens. He single-handedly founded the Xuantian Palace, and had thirty-six heavenly generals and seventy-two earthly evil spirits under his command. Any one of them would be a giant who could overthrow a continent.
He practiced for three hundred years and survived ninety-nine calamities without ever losing.
Only once.
When he was going through the tenth level of heavenly calamity, the "Eternal Catastrophe", the power of heaven's punishment far exceeded expectations. Three calamities, including the Nine Heavens Divine Thunder, the World-Destroying Black Flame, and the Time and Space Turbulence, all came together. He tried his best to block the two calamities, but his soul was torn apart by the time and space turbulence.
Before he died, he used the forbidden technique "Reincarnation and Rebirth Technique" to throw the fragments of his soul into reincarnation and live a new life.
Then he found that he had become a fourteen-year-old loser in the Fang family.
Memories of his previous life flooded into his mind, and it took him more than half a year to fully integrate them. The owner of this body, also named Fangyuan, is a descendant of the Fang family. His father, Fang Canghai, was once a famous genius in Qingzhou. He tempered the ninth level of body tempering at the age of fifteen and entered the Qi Condensation realm at the age of eighteen. He was praised asIt is "the first in Qingzhou in a century".
However, fifteen years ago, Fang Cang went abroad for training and never returned, his life and death unknown. His mother died in childbirth after giving birth to him.
Without the protection of his genius father, Fang Yuan's status in the Fang family plummeted. The Fang family is a wealthy family that values ​​strength. Children with no background, no talent, and no backing are weeds that everyone can bully.
Fangyuan slowly sat up, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and looked as deep as an abyss.
"Fang Lie, the Fang family..." He whispered to himself, his voice hoarse but with a calmness beyond his age, "I have been in seclusion for too long, so long that even ants dare to be arrogant in front of me."
His predecessor had been unable to break through the first level of body tempering for fourteen years. Everyone thought he had poor talent and was a waste among wastes.
But after merging memories, Fangyuan discovered the truth - this body was born with blocked meridians and a shrunken Dantian. It was indeed a "body with no meridians" that was rarely seen in thousands of years. In the eyes of ordinary people, this is a waste material among waste materials, and the path to cultivation is dead.
But in the eyes of Emperor Xuan——
This is a unique cultivation genius!
Although the meridians of the Jumai Body are blocked, the endurance of the flesh and bones is far beyond that of ordinary people. The meridians of ordinary people are like rivers, and spiritual power can flow smoothly; the body of Juemian has no rivers, but his flesh and blood is like the sea, and he can store massive amounts of power without rivers.
